reasoning_input.question_text: Evaluate (1 + i√3)⁶ using De Moivre's theorem.

student_steps.content: In polar form: z = 2(cos(π/3) + i sin(π/3)) = 2 e^(i π/3).
By De Moivre's theorem: z⁶ = (2 e^(i π/3))⁶ = 2⁶ · e^(i · 6 · π/3) = 64 e^(i · 2π).

steps.description: Write z in polar / exponential form
Apply De Moivre's Theorem correctly: z⁶ = 2⁶ (cos 2π + i sin 2π)
